top_stories.title: Amnesty calls for end to EU asylum outsourcing to Albania
top_stories.summary: Amnesty International has urged the European Union to stop outsourcing asylum processing to Albania. The organization alleges that Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni is using authoritarian tactics to advance the deal.

sources.headline: Amnesty demands EU stops ‘outsourcing asylum’ and accuses Meloni of authoritarian tricks to push Albania deal

top_stories.title: ICC labels US sanctions as attack on judicial independence
top_stories.summary: The International Criminal Court has described United States sanctions against it as a flagrant attack on its judicial independence. The warning was issued by France 24 English.

sources.headline: ICC says US sanctions 'flagrant attack' on court independence
